# Manual: https://zsh.sourceforge.io/Doc/Release/Redirection.html#Redirection
# Manual: https://zsh.sourceforge.io/Doc/Release/Expansion.html#Command-Substitution
# Issue #686: a here-document whose body starts inside a command substitution
# reads the `)` as body text and ends at the end of the file, so the
# substitution never closes. Top level; zsh -f -n reports: parse error near
# `$(cat <<EOF'.
print $(cat <<EOF
hi
)
